The problem

TikTok pays you in pieces.

Platform commission, affiliate commission, shipping and a refund three weeks later all come off. By the time the money lands, it rarely matches what you sold.

Gross sales£62.00
Seller discounts−£2.00
Platform commission−£5.40
Affiliate commission−£3.10
Shipping fee−£2.75
Partial refund, 3 weeks later−£8.00
Your payout£40.75

Multiply that across every order and every month, and “What am I actually making?” stops being a simple question.

MyShopEdge puts it back together, automatically.

Your figures stay yours.

MyShopEdge only reads your data. It can’t act on your shop, and you can disconnect any time.

MyShopEdge can read your shop, and it can never change it.

It has no permission to place orders, issue refunds or touch your money.

Your TikTok access is stored encrypted.

Every connection to MyShopEdge uses HTTPS.

A registered UK company runs it.

Inspirecraft Global Ltd is registered with Companies House.

You can delete everything.

Delete your account and its data whenever you want, from Settings.

How it works

You are set up in three steps.

Connect your shop once, and MyShopEdge updates your figures every day.

1

Connect your TikTok Shop

You approve read-only access on TikTok’s own page.

2

We read your history

MyShopEdge reads up to 24 months of your orders and payouts, and updates them every day.

3

See your gross profit

Your gross profit is there for today, for this month and for the tax year.

What you get

MyShopEdge shows you every figure that matters.

Products

See which products earn you the most, and which cost you.

Your gross profit is shown product by product, down to a single unit.

Stock

Know what’s running out before it does.

You see your stock on hand, what has sold and what is coming back.

Returns

Each return is checked and counted once.

You mark each return as resellable or not, and your stock and write-offs follow.

Money

Every fee TikTok takes is named and totalled.

No deduction is folded into another line.

Tax

Set aside tax without doing the maths.

MyShopEdge estimates the Income Tax and National Insurance a sole trader should set aside. It also shows your turnover over the last twelve months against the VAT registration threshold.
